QuestInfo.name: The Kid and the Curse
QuestInfo.0: The Goddess Teardrop was most likely around #m323000000#, but #p2430001# wasn't willing to give up the clues Alpha and Beta would need to find it. Their next, best hope was #b#p2430003##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2430003# refused to talk in town, but offered a private chat in #b#MDmap323090100##k. The duo headed toward the #bdungeon portal#k, and wondered what was coming next.
QuestInfo.2: The talk with #p2430003# in #m323090100# produced the same name the duo had already heard: #p2430000#. The boy is known for being a little strange... and that might be just what they were looking for.

npc.0: Keep your voices down! The people of this peaceful village aren't used to all the hustle and bustle. We can talk about things in #b#MDmap323090100##k, away from their prying ears.
